method: read official verifier test-stdout from the 16-task pilot, then compared instruction.md, environment/, solution/, tests/ by hand. No LLM.

outliers.verifier_evidence: pytest collection error: tests/harness.py imports warehouse.jobs.first_load (ingest_shards, publish_if_pending, replay_interrupt, resume_load). No warehouse/jobs/ exists in environment/ or solution/. instruction.md names ingest/probe/resume/pipeline commands under /app/warehouse but never a jobs.first_load module.
outliers.label: INVALID
outliers.why_grade: mechanical: ImportError at collection; reference cannot pass under any reading of the instruction

outliers.verifier_evidence: 16/17 tests pass; test_live_json_snips_misses_mixed_log reads /app/policies/live.json. environment/policies has only logging.json and target.json. instruction.md never names live.json. solution does not create it. tests/generator.py comment says 'Do not read live.json'.
outliers.label: INVALID
outliers.why_grade: mechanical: FileNotFoundError on a path absent from environment, instruction, and solution

outliers.verifier_evidence: instruction names runner.py as the entry point and tests invoke it via subprocess. environment/runner.py exists and is copied into /app/warehouse by the Dockerfile. diff environment/runner.py vs solution/runner.py is 23 lines: one unused import removed, one comment block removed, one json.dumps reformatted. No behavioral change. The dropped 'cp' therefore left a behaviorally identical runner in place.
outliers.label: VALID
outliers.why_grade: the heuristic 'drop last apply' removed a cosmetic file; the verifier was right to accept it
outliers.lesson: grade-C probes must not be counted as negatives; this is the concrete case ADR-0018 predicted

summary: 3/16 pilot tasks flagged. 2 confirmed materially invalid from artifacts alone (reference cannot pass its own verifier because tests require unstated paths). 1 was a treatment-label error (grade C probe dropped a no-op file); verifier correct. 14/16 clean. A/B-only false_accept stays 0.
